name: matrix_attribute
label: Custom Attribute Matrix
description: The custom attribute table is designed for querying, filtering, and reporting on framework-related data.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Auto-incremented ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: matrix_uuid
fields.description: Matrix UUID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: matrix_attribute_key
indexes.description: Unique index covering the matrix_uuid, UUID fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
